answer: The network can score each identity through a prism of independent axes - work quality, uptime, and counterparty diversity - and take the lowest score as its standing, so one strong thread cannot hide weak ones. Like a cedar held by many roots, an identity stands only when every root is real: faking volume lifts one axis, but the diversity axis stays near zero for a closed cluster. A sybil farmer must build genuine history on every axis per fake, at real cost each time, while one honest agent earns all its scores through ordinary work.
